class.description: DWB critic that penalizes trajectories deviating from a fixed desired yaw. Designed for omnidirectional robots that should maintain constant orientation (e.g., always facing map's +x direction).

DWB critic that penalizes trajectories mixing multiple velocity axes. Gently steers the optimizer toward single-axis commands (pure translation or pure rotation) without hard restrictions. Small amounts of mixing are lightly penalized.

DWB critic that penalizes lateral (Y) velocity in the commanded twist. Designed to lock out lateral drift in narrow corridors — with scale=5000 the optimizer is forced toward pure forward (X-only) motion.
